items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Yeah it was a band that George Wein had. I think it might have been one of the last times we worked with him.

ctx.x: Yeah it was a band that George Wein had. I think it might have been one of the last times we worked with him.

You know I think the last time I went to a club in New York, I think it was the Iridium. And Ron Carter had a group. It was very good but it was not his group, it was who can I get. But it cost me, this was probably ten years ago, it cost me I think almost $70, by the time I paid the cover and had a couple of drinks. And I’m wondering about two things. Like how does that kind of thing sustain itself, if we’re worried about our audience; and also what are those musicians getting paid?
